prompt_en: Photorealistic editorial inside a humid botanical glasshouse at blue hour. One unmistakably adult woman with long, dark, softly waved hair swept behind both shoulders dominates a vertical full-body frame, head and ankle-level hems inside. Treat the supplied portrait as a facial and general appearance reference for an adult. She calibrates a suspended kinetic sculpture using a brass tension wheel at her right side and a compact optical tachometer held low at her left side. Both stay lateral to torso, waist, central rise, and inseam. She wears a graphite tailored one-piece bifurcated jumpsuit with a restrained V neckline and fitted sleeves; matte lightweight crepe absorbs the greenhouse shadows while retaining a fine tactile grain. the upper garment and waist remain one continuous unit, with the tailored bodice flowing uninterrupted across the torso; the same garment continues through a visible crotch, while waist shaping flows into the central rise; a visible inseam separates two independent legs, and each trouser leg reads as its own moving branch; full-length trouser legs define the selected jumpsuit, ending in two distinct ankle-level hems. a dress hem cannot substitute for the two-leg split, and a matching top and trousers remain two garments and do not substitute. A relaxed slight stride keeps two long trouser columns separated from hip to ankle, and true stitched construction lines stay crisp around the central rise and inseam. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Dichroic fins rotate behind her, casting plausible cyan, magenta, amber, and emerald caustics across glass, leaves, and wet stone. The colored caustics remain broad irregular reflections offset from the garment's true seams, whose stitching stays materially distinct. One halted fin makes maintenance legible. A side humidity gauge provides recognizable photographic evidence of atmospheric ground-observation record. Eye-level perspective, crisp texture, controlled depth, clean silhouette.
